texts: good. the question is asked as a standing habit with the unknown in the doer slot, nightmoths as the kind repelled and the lantern in the whence (from) slot, and nothing added beyond what you asked. One thing to keep steady on your side: a bare answering statement like "smokeleaf repels nightmoths" is filed as a kind-to-kind relation that this question's event shape cannot reach, so keep the lantern in the sentence that answers it.
